what: For each human-confirmed consequential error: does the judge's failed requirement describe the same error the reviewer found? Read from the saved judgment (latest sel/sel2 run) against the verified reviewer note. Site copy, not a label: labels and judgments are unchanged.
written_by: Claude (assistant), from the saved judgments and the verified reviewer notes, at the author's request

values.same: the judge's failed requirement names the error the reviewer found
values.related: same kind of error in the same document, on a different item or clause
values.different: the judge failed the document for another reason
